title: Correction to: Three-Dimensional Quantification of Spheroid Degradation-Dependent Invasion and Invadopodia Formation
author: Goertzen, Eymael, et al.

steps.instruction: It has come to the authors’ attention that the representative image of the unstimulated UMSCC1 spheroid at Day 1 in Fig. 1a was selected from the wrong data set. The image in the original article [1] was taken from a data set for another study by the authors [2]. The revised Fig. 1 including a representative image of the unstimulated UMSCC1 spheroid at Day 1 taken from the correct study data set is available in this erratum.Fig. 1Representative images of spheroid Geltrex™ degradation. Representative confocal images of UMSCC1 (a) or MDA-MB-231 (b) spheroids causing Geltrex™ degradation signalling at Day 0, 7, and 14 or Day 0, 2, and 4, respectively. Spheroid volume was revealed through bright-field imaging and Geltrex™ degradation through 488 nm excitation/515 emission. c 3D images of MDA-MB-231 cells showing both a spheroid and a background of highly invasive cells that attached to the bottom of the slides. Scale bar, 100 μm. Images are representative of three repetitions
